title: Minimum, maximum, and ok
hints: The third result, ok, tells the caller whether the other two mean anything. For an empty slice, return 0, 0, false.
Don't start min and max at 0: if every number is positive, min would stay 0. Start both at the first element instead.
if len(nums) == 0 { return 0, 0, false }; lo, hi = nums[0], nums[0]; then loop over nums[1:] and update lo and hi; return lo, hi, true.
